categories.name: Crafting Recipes
categories.description: 3D Printer recipes (FOB printer unlocks at DMZ Level 2; codmunity progression says Level 1). Printer tabs: Upgrades, Consumables, Plate Carriers, Backpacks, Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades, Fire Support, Gear, Ingredients (gamerfuzion, Game Rant). Upgrades-tab items are tracked under FOB / 3D Printer Upgrades. Recipes unlock by DMZ Level, DMZ Orders, Story Missions, or by looting a 'Recipe' in Hajin ('Found in Hajin') and extracting it: the recipe is consumed at exfil, added to the printer permanently, and pays 5,000 DMZ Cash, duplicates included (gamerfuzion, metaradar, gamingpromax). Recipes are lost if you die with them. Costs use four resources (Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, Metals; loot breaks down automatically) plus named Ingredients. All FOB printing happens from stash between deployments; the only in-match printer reported is the X01 Production Assembly printer. The Field Crafting trait reportedly allows crafting from Common resources while deployed (no recipe list documented). Recipe count conflicts: metaradar 94, Game Rant 'over 107'.

categories.name: Weapons & Weapon Manuals
categories.description: Gunsmith sells launch weapons (count reported as 32, 33, or 35 incl. later additions). Weapon Manuals are loot items: extracting a weapon's manual consumes it at exfil and permanently unlocks that weapon for purchase at the Gunsmith (games.gg, conquestcapped, gfinity); each extracted manual pays 5,000 DMZ Cash, duplicates included (conquestcapped). Extracting 3 manuals for the same weapon unlocks its War Spoils camo (games.gg, conquestcapped, codmunity). Conquestcapped words it as 'three manuals for the equipped weapon' and notes player reports of some manuals not counting, so check challenge progress after each run. Manuals are lost if you die with them. Per-weapon ladder: Military 1-8, 3 Special, Gold, Platinum, Harmonic Break, Divergence.
